title: Nullable Types
description: Learn about nullable value types and nullable reference types in C#.

data.text: **Nullable types** allow value types to represent null values, and nullable reference types help prevent null reference exceptions at compile time.

data.title: Nullable Value Types
Nullable Reference Types
Enable Nullable Reference Types
data.text: Add `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>` to your .csproj file. This gives you compile-time warnings for potential null reference exceptions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Nullable reference types prevent null bugs
data.takeaway: Nullable types help you handle null safely.
